description:
GISGP Lite ($3 a month, or $1 once for 24 hours) — pass the api_key of that
    account (or Authorization: Bearer). contour lines for a box `bbox=[west, south, east, north]` (degrees) or a
    GeoJSON `polygon`, from Copernicus 30 m (`source="cop30"`, worldwide, up to 100 km² per box) or
    USGS 10 m (`"usgs10"`, US, up to 25 km²). `interval` in `units` ("m" or "ft"; omit for an
    automatic interval), `format` geojson | kml | kmz | shp | dxf | dxf3d | landxml | preview,
    `crs` an EPSG code for the DXF / LandXML (default: the UTM zone). Returns JSON: GeoJSON
    with stats for geojson/preview; for files {ok, filename, data_base64} or {ok, download_url}.
name: generate_contours
